patch.summary: CircleCI cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: CircleCI pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Trial/free path present in researched plans

blocks.title: CircleCI plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: log management, CI/CD and automation, developer AI assistance · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Performance
lines.description: Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Scale
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: CircleCI cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price CircleCI against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (log management, CI/CD and automation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Not a git host — you still need GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket for source control. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams that want specialist CI/CD against an existing GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket remote requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Not a git host — you still need GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket for source control
Side-by-side cost with GitHub on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Not a git host — you still need GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket for source control

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Same source-control-devops cluster as GitHub, but GitHub the SCM is a different primary shape

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Free minute/credit caps; Performance list price is not unlimited CI

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not observability, on-call, hosting panel, or managed hosting

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs CircleCI on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model it-development spend with CircleCI in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for CircleCI alongside category cost modelling.
